summary: the agents suite's muse and muse-tmux rows on x86-64 against a script whose commit has the wrong author; the Model API exchange still succeeds, so the host must reject the returned history; the base also runs the claude and gh rows; the fake server reads the script as it is, so nothing is built

argv: case ${PHASE} in base) rows='claude gh muse muse-tmux' ;; *) rows='muse muse-tmux' ;; esac; ARCH=x86_64 RACH2_AGENTS_ROWS="$rows" exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run agents

faults.name: author
faults.summary: the commit the fake API asks Muse to make is made with user.name Impostor
